Scientists helping scientists Our story We’re chemists who spent years fighting tools that didn’t understand our work. So we built something different: an operating system designed by people who’ve actually synthesized materials. Albert was forged in real labs by scientists with decades of experience at Dow, BASF, PPG, and Henkel. We believe science should feel like exploration, not administration. An operating system built for chemistry Centralize every project, material, and experiment in a living record that grows with each discovery, so you can leave a lasting legacy with your work. Capture every experiment at the molecular level in a way that’s structured, consistent, and ready to train AI models. AI that chemists will actually want to use Most AI models give you generic predictions trained on someone else’s data. Ours learns from a foundation of 15 million molecular structures, then trains on your experiments—delivering insights that make sense for your chemistry. Your partner in measurable outcomes Digital transformation starts with understanding where you are. Learn how we work with our partners to double their speed to market, cut development cycles from months to days, and launch entirely new revenue channels. One operating system. Every capacity. Compliance that doesn’t slow you down Instead, you have safety data sheets and labels at your fingertips, with built-in regulatory rules for 400,000 chemical substances. Change management that drives adoption From readiness assessments to training programs to ongoing support from our team—we help you transform, not just implement software. AI trained on your chemistry Predict properties, optimize formulations, and design better experiments with models that learn from your data and get smarter over time. Your data stays yours and stays secure Built with certified security standards, controlled access for different roles, and connections to your existing systems.
